# Third-party notices

RTRT incorporates the third-party components listed below. Their source code and
full license texts are retained in `Dependencies/`.

## GLFW

`Dependencies/glfw` provides window creation, input, and OpenGL context support.
Copyright (c) 2002-2006 Marcus Geelnard and (c) 2006-2019 Camilla Löwy.
It is distributed under the zlib/libpng license; see `Dependencies/glfw/LICENSE.md`.

## GLEW

`Dependencies/glew-2.1.0` provides OpenGL extension loading.
Copyright (c) 2002-2007 Milan Ikits, Marcelo E. Magallon, and Lev Povalahev,
with additional Mesa and Khronos components. It is distributed under a
BSD-style license with additional MIT-licensed components; see
`Dependencies/glew-2.1.0/LICENSE.txt`.

## GLM

`Dependencies/glm` provides mathematics types and functions.
Copyright (c) 2005 - G-Truc Creation. It is available under the Happy Bunny
License or the MIT License; RTRT uses it under the MIT License. See
`Dependencies/glm/copying.txt`.

## Dear ImGui

`Dependencies/imgui` provides the user interface.
Copyright (c) 2014-2026 Omar Cornut. It is distributed under the MIT License;
see `Dependencies/imgui/LICENSE.txt`.

## ImGuizmo

`Dependencies/imguizmo` provides transform gizmos for Dear ImGui.
Copyright (c) 2016 Cedric Guillemet. It is distributed under the MIT License;
see `Dependencies/imguizmo/LICENSE`.

## nlohmann/json

`Dependencies/nlohmann-json` provides JSON parsing and serialization.
Copyright (c) 2013-2021 Niels Lohmann. It is distributed under the MIT License;
see `Dependencies/nlohmann-json/LICENSE.MIT`.

## nativefiledialog

`Dependencies/nativefiledialog` provides native scene-file dialogs in RenderLab.
It is distributed under the Zlib license; see
`Dependencies/nativefiledialog/LICENSE`.

## RadeonRays

`Dependencies/RadeonRays` provides BVH construction code.
Copyright (c) 2016 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. It is distributed under the MIT
License; see the license notice at the beginning of the source files, for
example `Dependencies/RadeonRays/bbox.h`.

## stb

`Dependencies/stb` provides image loading, resizing, and writing utilities.
Copyright (c) Sean Barrett and contributors. It is dual-licensed under the MIT
License and the public domain; RTRT may use either alternative. See the license
notice at the end of each bundled header, for example
`Dependencies/stb/stb_image.h`.

## tinybvh

`Dependencies/tinybvh` provides CPU BVH construction utilities.
Copyright (c) 2024 Jacco Bikker / Breda University of Applied Sciences. It is
distributed under the MIT License; see `Dependencies/tinybvh/tiny_bvh.h`.

## tinydir

`Dependencies/tinydir` provides directory enumeration.
Copyright (c) 2013-2021 tinydir authors. It is distributed under the BSD 2-Clause
License; see `Dependencies/tinydir/tinydir.h`.

## TinyGLTF

`Dependencies/tinygltf` provides glTF parsing.
Copyright (c) 2015-present Syoyo Fujita, Aurélien Chatelain, and contributors.
It is distributed under the MIT License; see `Dependencies/tinygltf/tiny_gltf.h`.
The bundled `json.hpp` is nlohmann/json and is also MIT-licensed; see
`Dependencies/tinygltf/json.hpp`.

## tinyobjloader

`Dependencies/tinyobjloader` provides OBJ and MTL parsing.
Copyright (c) 2012-present Syoyo Fujita and contributors. It is distributed
under the MIT License; see `Dependencies/tinyobjloader/tiny_obj_loader.h`.
